reply.summary: Iumcost is a far-future keeper who tends a hollow relic from a drifting orbital outpost, watching a manufactured star for signs of unrest. Weary of inherited duty, the keeper bends the relic's beams to rewrite his own bloodline.

feats.scene: Iumcost fires the relic at a rogue patrol fleet and burns it from the sky in a single sweeping beam.
Iumcost stands unharmed as a collapsing docking ring crushes the platform around him.

reply.summary: Selltil is a ruthless temple aide who treats loyalty as a ladder, collecting followers while elders fade. Quick with accusations and slow to forgive, Selltil turns a tribe's fear of outsiders into a throne for a hired champion.

feats.scene: Selltil strikes a rival steward down with a ceremonial spear before the council can object.
Selltil walks away from a collapsing banquet hall with only bruises.

reply.summary: Tiarnrni is a desert monarch who steadied a wandering people and then gambled that stability on a border war. Tiarnrni hides a fugitive agitator and jails an old founder, only to be overpowered in her own throne room.

feats.scene: Tiarnrni cleaves a training dummy and its stand in half with one royal blade swing.
Tiarnrni shrugs off a collapsing tent pole and a scatter of arrows during a siege drill.

reply.summary: Ntstu is a shifting spirit of style who spins unsettling tales for anyone who lingers near her cauldron. Each decade Ntstu swaps costume, slogan and nickname to match whatever fad is loud, and she is missing one eye.

feats.scene: Ntstu stirs her cauldron and a bolt of stitched-together lightning scorches a tailor's shop front.
Ntstu sits unbothered while a wardrobe of enchanted coats collapses on her.

reply.summary: Rnuanlla is a blond hired menace who bends the momentum of anything already moving. Hurled bricks, speeding cars and falling girders all swerve at Rnuanlla's whim, though still objects are beyond reach.

feats.scene: Rnuanlla redirects a skidding truck into a brick wall without touching it.
Rnuanlla survives a rooftop tumble with a sprained wrist.

reply.summary: Orsear is a calm, blond dealmaker who runs a trading house in a walled metropolis and speaks in long, patient sentences. Orsear never fights; every conflict is settled by contract, delay or a well-timed refusal.

feats.scene: Orsear slaps a ledger onto a desk hard enough to silence a boardroom.
Orsear takes a stumble down a marble staircase and stands back up to resume negotiating.

reply.summary: Nilamor is a bald, heavyset street boss who leads a loud crew of painted joyriders through the avenues at night. Nilamor settles disputes with a thick fist and a louder laugh.

feats.scene: Nilamor drives a fist through a car window while the crew cheers.
Nilamor laughs off a crash that leaves a stolen sedan crumpled around him.

reply.summary: Lannansu is the primordial father of every tide-god, an ocean given a face and a grudge. Lannansu grew furious at his children's endless inventions inside his waters, died of that rage, and now returns as a stern ferryman for proud deep-sea divinities.

feats.scene: Lannansu rears up as a wall of water and drowns a drifting coastline in one surge.
Lannansu absorbs a storm-god's thunder across the open sea and merely ripples.

reply.summary: Amniau commands a hidden counter-disaster agency and sheds a body at each year's turning, emerging in a fresh shape every time. The new bodies vary wildly in size and age, but the sharp mind and iron command carry over untouched.

feats.scene: Amniau flips a steel desk across a briefing room to end an argument.
Amniau walks out of a collapsed bunker wall with a fresh body and no wound.

reply.summary: Tiuli is an island wrestler who nearly beat the eventual champion in a tournament of lances and holds. Long life from a sacred spring keeps Tiuli strong across centuries.

feats.scene: Tiuli pins a challenger in the sand ring and cracks the wooden railing with her shoulder.
Tiuli takes a full-speed lance charge and keeps grappling.

reply.summary: Stivosium is a dark-haired trader in a walled metropolis, known for bargains that no customer fully understands. Stivosium keeps an eye on a niece with a gift for spells.

feats.scene: Stivosium shoves a market stall over to block a pursuer.
Stivosium rides out a cart collision with a torn sleeve.

reply.summary: Miren is a harbor-town mother who once gave up an adopted girl for money reasons and kept the shame secret for seventeen years. Miren later welcomes the grown daughter back onto her lawn with tears and an open door.

feats.scene: Miren swings a skillet at a trespassing raccoon and sends it over the fence.
Miren falls off a porch ladder while hanging lights and gets up laughing.

reply.summary: Sonrilta is a pink-haired schemer who bought dark power by betraying a partner, and can make whole streets seem to vanish. Cover her eyes and the whole trick collapses.

feats.scene: Sonrilta erases an entire plaza from the sight of every watcher, then walks through it unnoticed.
Sonrilta takes a patrol car's bumper to the hip and keeps running.

reply.summary: Lenani is a quiet hired tracker who works with a partner and collects fugitives for pay. Lenani prefers patience, ropes and a long stakeout to any loud brawl.

feats.scene: Lenani drops a fleeing smuggler with one flying tackle.
Lenani rolls out of a moving van and keeps the trail.

reply.summary: Orlitor is a former trapeze hand turned fixer for killers, wired with a head implant that broadcasts raw agony into a victim's mind. The same signal can be turned back on its sender.

feats.scene: Orlitor floods a captive's thoughts with relived mistakes until the man begs for release.
Orlitor stumbles through a shattered window and walks off with cuts and a limp.

reply.summary: Liatise is a red-haired student who carries a blade haunted by an ancient king. The weapon sharpens her strength and lets her slice open the seam between realms to reach a hidden castle.

feats.scene: Liatise slashes a parked bus in two and splits the air itself behind it.
Liatise is flung through a stone wall by a spectral knight and rises with a bruise.

reply.summary: Viamcel is a drama-loving cheerleader with a talent for kitchen chemistry who briefly brews a potion of instant devotion. Viamcel recovers from a coma, changes her first name and drifts back to ordinary school life.

feats.scene: Viamcel shoves a rival into a locker with a well-aimed shoulder.
Viamcel survives a swarm of stings that put her in bed for weeks.

reply.summary: Seiumli is a brown-haired inmate in a swampy prison whose estranged sister fears for her life. Seiumli digs up a buried secret near a bayou shack and flinches from every hand that reaches out.

feats.scene: Seiumli swings a shovel at a pursuer and cracks the handle.
Seiumli wades through a thorny marsh for hours and arrives scratched but upright.

reply.summary: Lieoci is a black-haired city legislator and senior member of a hooded order that picks its enforcer. Lieoci survives an arrow in the arm during a night raid and later testifies to police.

feats.scene: Lieoci hurls a heavy gavel across a chamber to stop a heckler.
Lieoci leaves a burning meeting hall on foot with an arrow lodged in her arm.

reply.summary: Iumriate is a lone black-haired rebel hiding in a city ruled by a sorcerous mayor after her whole crew was wiped out. Captured and brought before him, Iumriate swears she will never stop resisting.

feats.scene: Iumriate shorts out a patrol gate with a hacked terminal and a thrown wrench.
Iumriate endures a night in a cell and a beating without giving up a name.

reply.summary: Tianesla is a retired killer for a secretive cell who hid that past from a husband for years. When her old employers press her to take a life, Tianesla is stopped by her own child.

feats.scene: Tianesla drops a guard with a single chop and takes his rifle.
Tianesla takes a car door to the ribs and fires back anyway.

reply.summary: Iureo is a two-foot feline mystic, formerly a dojo teacher, whose stirring stick became a wand when a meteor struck the pot. The wand throws blasts, hops its owner across town and reads the next few seconds.

feats.scene: Iureo points the wand and a violet bolt blows a hole through a docked cargo barge.
Iureo's costume of pure charm turns aside a falling crate of scrap iron.

reply.summary: Ststtiu is a clumsy, kind-hearted teen who loves games and comics and always seems to wear a bandage. Ststtiu admires the local hero and believes too easily in loud rescuers.

feats.scene: Ststtiu throws a wild punch at a bully and misses, hitting a locker.
Ststtiu tumbles down a flight of school steps and bounces up smiling.

reply.summary: Corausti is a bookish bald thief who idolizes a legendary armored outlaw, until a blow to the skull convinces him that he is that outlaw. His gang humors the delusion hoping for buried jewels.

feats.scene: Corausti charges a doorway in a tin helmet and splinters the frame.
Corausti takes a knock to the head that rewrites his whole personality.

reply.summary: Iuallall is a purple-eyed occultist with a rasping voice who trades in forbidden rites and borrowed power. Iuallall prefers chalk circles, whispered bargains and long grudges to open fighting.

feats.scene: Iuallall chants a name backward and a roaring column of green flame guts a rented warehouse.
Iuallall sits through a collapsing ceiling inside a ward of pale light.

reply.summary: Iunurn is a robed prophet of a sinister order who foretells doom from an inverted pulpit. Iunurn's spells draw on the fear of crowds, and the sorcerer serves a ruthless league of outlaws.

feats.scene: Iunurn raises both arms and a hail of black glass shreds a convoy of tanks.
Iunurn stands in the blast of a shell without a scratch, wrapped in murmuring shadow.

reply.summary: Rnusto is a cold-eyed officer from a hawk-like warrior race who commands covert strike teams and plots a hidden invasion. Keen sight and hearing, long life and extra stamina let Rnusto outlast ordinary humans, and a mind-reading device aids interrogations.

feats.scene: Rnusto bends a steel gate open to reach a hostage.
Rnusto shrugs off a rifle volley that would drop a human soldier.

reply.summary: Sarreoser is a wind deity built from stolen shape-changing technology and sent to fool a nation into believing its old gods had returned. Sarreoser roars about heaven's wrath while sweeping through the cities in gales.

feats.scene: Sarreoser spins a gale across a harbor district and flattens a block of warehouses.
Sarreoser takes a salvo from a squad of armored soldiers and the wounds ripple shut.

reply.summary: Rauirn is a proud top cadet who once shared a bench with his closest friend and now seethes at being passed over for a masked title. Rauirn demands the cowl at knifepoint and loses to a trick of sleeping vapor.

feats.scene: Rauirn drives a staff through a practice dummy and the post behind it.
Rauirn keeps fighting through a dozen blows in a drill arena.

reply.summary: Liessan is an orphaned girl who survived three kidnappings and now fights with knives she learned to use in captivity. Liessan swears often and wants to stop wicked adults for good.

feats.scene: Liessan hurls a blade into a rafter and cuts the rope holding a crate over her friend.
Liessan drops from a loft onto a pile of boxes and runs on.

reply.summary: Reraueo is a soft-spoken spirit-talker who knows how to reach voices that do not want to be found. Reraueo works as the trusted contact for a trench-coated occultist and keeps a pistol for bad nights.

feats.scene: Reraueo opens a séance circle and a rattling poltergeist hurls a table across the room.
Reraueo staggers through a ghost's cold grip and keeps talking.

reply.summary: Leoliu is a monstrous two-toned wolf of northern legend, foretold to devour the chief of the gods when the world ends. Leoliu once snapped off a war-god's hand and hunts old dinner guests to take back the memories he lent them.

feats.scene: Leoliu leaps and crushes a mountain fortress in his jaws, scattering the rubble for miles.
Leoliu shakes off the blows of an entire army of storm-spirits and lunges again.

reply.summary: Anuleo is a red-eyed wolf-god kept as a secret siege weapon by a scheming ruler, and grows more powerful the larger it becomes. Anuleo rides a living seat of power into battle against a rival reality.

feats.scene: Anuleo swells to the height of a skyline and tramples a walled continent's border into dust.
Anuleo endures the combined fire of a dimension's guardians without slowing.
Anuleo bounds across the battlefield in a blur of grey fur.

reply.summary: Isirn is a child singer whose talent earned a record contract and the jealousy of a twin. Isirn's career ends on a snapped playground swing, and the family keeps the lid closed.

feats.scene: Isirn pushes a swing high with a laugh and a shove.
Isirn tumbles from a low branch and brushes off the dirt.

reply.summary: Rnvalvau is a damned buccaneer who was once an enslaved islander, then led a revolt against his captors. Seeking revenge for a murdered family, Rnvalvau decapitates a rival captain and returns to find his crew turned to the walking dead.

feats.scene: Rnvalvau swings a cutlass and lops a rival captain's head from his shoulders.
Rnvalvau stands through a broadside that splinters his deck.

reply.summary: Russe is a towering white-eyed refugee from a ravaged peaceful world who joined an interstellar police corps to avenge it. Exiled for abandoning his people's gentle ways, Russe grows hollow after failing to protect one more village.

feats.scene: Russe smashes a smuggler's hover-truck apart with his bare fists.
Russe absorbs a plasma salvo on his forearm and keeps advancing.

reply.summary: Niuvosstu is a corrupt corporate chief who secretly builds weapons that freeze, and ruins a scientist to protect them. Niuvosstu ends up arrested after a clumsy attack on a masked detective.

feats.scene: Niuvosstu swings a clumsy punch at a masked detective and meets the floor.
Niuvosstu is knocked out cold by a single blow and wakes up cuffed.

reply.summary: Feska is a Zaroxian thief from the slums who now guards a whole sector with a power ring. Feska raises her young son in cramped lodgings and loves her partner.

feats.scene: Feska forms a green hammer from her ring and flattens a pirate cruiser's engine pod.
Feska raises a ring shield that holds against a point-blank cannon.

reply.summary: Nummavas is a yellow-skinned survivor of a peaceful civilization wiped out by plague in a week. Driven mad, Nummavas flies a city-sized ship across space to prove life is cruel and pointless.

feats.scene: Nummavas turns the ship's cannon on a moon-base and scorches it to slag.
Nummavas survives the wreck of the command deck and rises laughing.

reply.summary: Lloni is a white-haired swindler who poses as a famous concert violinist and carries a bow, a blade and a sidearm. Lloni plays a tune that dulls wills, then escapes by plane.

feats.scene: Lloni swings the violin case into a guard's jaw.
Lloni crashes the getaway plane in a field and limps off.

reply.summary: Ortorse is a sentient meadow of the dream realm that grows weary of being scenery and borrows the shape of a rumpled gentleman. Ortorse hides ancient rules behind a charming smile.

feats.scene: Ortorse rolls the entire meadow forward as a wave of grass and lifts a tower off its footing.
Ortorse is uprooted by a nightmare's claw and reforms in a blink of green.

reply.summary: Eolti is a lovely glade of forest and field who tires of being a dream and takes the form of a sweet, charming man. Eolti uses that disguise to help a young woman search for her brother.

feats.scene: Eolti bends a hundred trees into an arch and closes a pursuer's path.
Eolti is cut down by a dream-beast and grows back in the next breath.

reply.summary: Stsiatir is an island nation's veteran strongman who is swapped for a shape-changing double during an alien scheme. Stsiatir takes back his stage in the middle of a speech and rallies the crowds to turn on the impostors.

feats.scene: Stsiatir slams a podium and the whole plaza goes silent.
Stsiatir trudges through a jungle for days without rest.

reply.summary: Aslisser is a brown-haired acrobat who runs at blinding speed and hurls sparks and flame. Aslisser was born as a fan contest entry, built like a cape-wearing climber with borrowed lightning feet.

feats.scene: Aslisser unleashes a ball of fire and lightning that wrecks a row of parked cars.
Aslisser tumbles through a wall of crates and runs on with barely a scrape.
Aslisser crosses a stadium in the blink of an eye.

reply.summary: Telorleo is a green-skinned, red-eyed sea-born rebel pressed into a doomed task force after his brother's death. Telorleo swims with ease, reads minds a little and hits hard.

feats.scene: Telorleo wrenches a bulkhead door off its hinges and hurls it at a guard.
Telorleo shrugs off a burst of rifle fire and dives into the harbor.

reply.summary: Tirtan is an auburn-haired undersea queen born with a body made to survive crushing depths and to breathe water. Tirtan bore a long line of rulers who later shaped whole oceans.

feats.scene: Tirtan raises a hand at court and a trident-bearing guard bows.
Tirtan swims the deepest trench and returns unharmed by the crushing weight.

reply.summary: Veoton is a faceless servant of a dark master who wields blazing flames and torches whatever the master points at. Veoton fights a team of dial-wielding heroes.

feats.scene: Veoton hurls a sheet of flame that engulfs a parked delivery truck.
Veoton stands in the middle of a burning street and does not flinch.

reply.summary: Rollseo is a cultist who calls flame to heel and follows a hunter of heroes. Rollseo scorches rooftops to draw a team of veterans into an ambush.

feats.scene: Rollseo lights a rooftop water tank and the burst of steam throws a ledge wide.
Rollseo walks out of a collapsing burning loft without a mark.

reply.summary: Orsonal is a giant invader from a flame-bodied race who arrives inside a crystal meteor that shrinks passengers and copies them. Orsonal turns captured people and animals into servants made of fire, but suffocating the blaze knocks him out.

feats.scene: Orsonal towers over a harbor and rains flame on a row of docks and cranes.
Orsonal weathers a barrage of naval shells that pass through his burning body.

reply.summary: Entorser is a brown-haired arsonist who believes flame is a calling and burns the wickedness out of sinners. After a trial and a fire at an asylum, Entorser hunts the jurors until soaked in gasoline and set alight.

feats.scene: Entorser torches an old asylum wing and the whole roof falls in.
Entorser takes a scuffle against two masked fighters before the gasoline catches.
